cases.outcome: CONTROL_PASSES: explicit current_turn overlay expires; historical session preferences remain

root_cause: begin_turn currently calls set_preference(preferences, source_quote=user_text) for every non-proactive packet.
The fixture preferences object is a historical snapshot, not a preference asserted by the current message.
Because the current user text contains 这次, set_preference rewrites the whole supplied snapshot scope to current_turn.
The next new user turn clears that overlay. A fresh runtime never stored the snapshot in its session layer, so the historical values disappear.
Scope layering itself works when the historical session seed and the new current_turn instruction are supplied separately.

recommended_minimal_future_change.snapshot_contract: Treat begin_turn preferences as a historical snapshot. Initialize or reconcile its original scope/provenance explicitly; never substitute the current user_text as its source quote.
recommended_minimal_future_change.fresh_session_minimum: For this fixture, seed its historical values into session scope with an empty exact source_quote because none is provided; keep the descriptive source metadata. Do not manufacture historical user speech.
recommended_minimal_future_change.new_instruction_contract: Apply a new explicit instruction as a separate scoped update carrying its actual source_quote. Add a distinct structured update input processed after turn expiry and before packet capture, or use the existing set_preference plus a fresh same-turn packet.
recommended_minimal_future_change.avoid_secondary_regression: Do not blindly reapply an old snapshot over newer explicit session preferences; use initialization or a versioned snapshot merge.
recommended_minimal_future_change.version_policy: Keep run-03 and its runtime/results unchanged. Implement and test this correction under a later version; this report is only reproduction evidence.

limits: No claim about model response quality or latency is made.
The short overlay is an explicitly supplied test value derived from the current fixture request, not a newly invented historical preference.
